description.zh:
需要修改的类型。

description.en:
The type of attribute to modify. Valid values:

- MaintainTime: Modify the O\&M window.

- DBInstanceDescription: Modify the instance name.
The new value for the attribute.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun clickhouse modify-db-instance-attribute --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id cc-xxxxx --attribute-type DBInstanceDescription --attribute-value test --product clickhouse --api-version 2023-05-22 --region cn-hangzhou
